analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: We may share specific information with business partners or contractors when the information is needed to fulfill your request for a product or service.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Market to You
analysis.quote: We, our affiliate(s) and/or third parties may also promote products and service offerings to you via email, sms-text message, or telephone.

analysis.headline: Third-Party Cross-Site Tracking
analysis.quote: These companies may deliver ads that might also place cookies and otherwise track user behavior across third party websites.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Indefinitely
analysis.quote: Otherwise, your data will be stored indefinitely.

analysis.headline: Targeted Ads Track Your Interests
analysis.quote: We use Google Analytics’ 3rd-party audience data such as age, gender and interests to better understanding the behavior of our customers and work with companies that collect information about your online activities to provide advertising targeted to suit your interests and preferences.

analysis.headline: No Guarantee of Data Security
analysis.quote: Although we do our best to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee the security of your personal information transmitted to our website.

analysis.headline: Your Data Transfers to US
analysis.quote: By submitting information on this website, it is being transmitted to the US and you consent to that transfer.

analysis.headline: No Minors Under 13 Allowed
analysis.quote: This website is not intended for children under the age of 13 and you may not use this website or submit any data to this website if you are under the age of 13.
